title: Save the Smart List
learningGoal: Save a filtered view so it can be used again later.

items.title: Step 4
items.description: Give the list a clear name

items.title: List 1
items.description: Too vague - doesn't explain what it contains

items.title: Test
items.description: Not descriptive - temporary name that stayed

items.title: Contacts
items.description: Not helpful - all contacts are contacts

keyPoint: A clear Smart List name saves time later. You should know what the list does just by reading the name.

actionSteps.title: Use a clear name
actionSteps.description: Name it so you know what it does at a glance

actionSteps.title: Save and test
actionSteps.description: Save it and reopen to verify it works

quizzes.question: Why should Smart List names be clear?

options.option_text: They don't need to be clear
Clear names help you quickly understand what the list shows and when to use it

quizzes.explanation: Clear names like 'Hot Leads — Need Follow-Up' tell you exactly what the list contains and when to use it, saving time and preventing confusion.

quizzes.question: Which is an example of a GOOD Smart List name?
quizzes.explanation: 'Hot Leads — Need Follow-Up' is clear and specific, telling you exactly what the list contains and what action to take.

quizzes.question: What should you do after saving a Smart List?

options.option_text: Reopen it to verify it works correctly
Tell everyone not to use it

quizzes.explanation: After saving, you should reopen the Smart List to verify it shows the correct contacts and works as expected.
